Context: 17. Cash Handling Allowance to Cashiers

## 17. Cash Handling Allowance to Cashiers  
[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part-I]  
Power of Sanction.Ministries and Heads of Department may at their discretion appoint LDCs / UDCs / Assistants to perform the duties of Cashiers. An allowance is admissible to such person at rates given below.  
(i) The amount of allowance will depend on the average amount of monthly cash disbursed, excluding payments by cheques.  
Conditions.The amount of receipts should not be taken into account.
